def: A 4-bit floating-point encoding, E2M1 (1 sign, 2 exponent and 1 mantissa bit), with only eight magnitudes from 0 to 6, used in practice with shared block scale factors.
practice: The element type of MXFP4 and NVFP4; NVIDIA’s 2025 NVFP4 pretraining paper reports 2× FP8 math throughput on GB200 and 3× on GB300, and trains a 12B model on 10T tokens.
